$comment: ADR-037 register fragment (gateway-federated-api-discovery Task 1, REQ-FEDG-001). The external_api schema the three discovery fragments (kong-gateway-discovery.json, azure-apim-discovery.json, aws-apigateway-discovery.json) write into, and two example APIs from the Kong fixture so the inventory page is not empty on a demo install. Admin-only: an inventory of another gateway's APIs is operator information.

external_api.title: External API
external_api.summary: An API found on another vendor's gateway, listed next to integriq's own API products
external_api.description: One row per API a discovery synchronization found on a Kong, Azure API Management or Amazon API Gateway instance (gateway-federated-api-discovery REQ-FEDG-001). Written by the synchronization engine, never by hand: `gatewayApiId` is the vendor's own id and the synchronization's origin id. An API the vendor no longer returns is not deleted: the synchronization's `markEnded` disappearance policy writes `sourceEndedAt`, so the inventory shows it as no longer seen (REQ-FEDG-002).

gateway.title: Gateway
gateway.description: The discovery source the API was found on (its source slug), so two Kong instances stay apart

name.title: Name
name.description: The API's name on its gateway

version.title: Version
version.description: The API version the gateway reports; empty when it reports none

baseUrl.title: Base URL
baseUrl.description: Where the gateway serves the API

environment.title: Environment
environment.description: The stage or environment on the gateway (an Amazon stage, an Azure revision); empty when the gateway has none

gatewayApiId.title: Gateway API id
gatewayApiId.description: The vendor's own id for the API

gatewayUrl.title: On the gateway
gatewayUrl.description: A link to the API in the vendor's own console or Admin API

openApiDocument.title: OpenAPI description
openApiDocument.description: The OpenAPI document the gateway exports for this API, when it exposes one

lastSeen.title: Last seen
lastSeen.description: When a discovery run last found the API

sourceEndedAt.title: No longer seen since
sourceEndedAt.description: Written by the markEnded disappearance policy: the first run that no longer found the API
